Casellas Connors Elizabeth Carlino a School of Earth, Environment and Society, Portland State University, USAb Department of Geography, Texas A&M University, USAALIDA CANTOR is an Associate Professor of Geography in the School of Earth, Environment, and Society, Portland State University, Portland, OR, 97201. E-mail: acantor@pdx.edu. Her research is grounded in political ecology and focuses on water law and governance, renewable energy transitions, and environmental justice in the western United States.JOHN P. CASELLAS CONNORS is an Associate Professor of Geography at Texas A&M University, College Station, TX 77802. E-mail: jpcc@tamu.edu. His research spans political ecology, more-than-human geography, environmental politics, and gun studies.ELIZABETH CARLINO is a PhD Candidate in the Department of Geography at Texas A&M University, College Station, TX 77843. E-mail: elliecarlino@tamu.edu. Her research interests include legal geography, political ecology, climate change, and the right to water in South Africa.
